constraints: no clinical, financial, record or real appointment mutation

criteria.title: Six-source prompt provenance
criteria.target: All six sources are byte-identical and hash-bound; earlier source sets remain historical.
criteria.evidence: prompt archive README and prompt-integrity artifact

criteria.title: Visible candidate-bound certification
criteria.target: Current pointer and Phase 11 package are tracked, candidate scoped, descendant-reanchored and tamper-detecting.

criteria.title: Fail-closed certification calculus
criteria.target: False GO, profile escalation, stale/dirty/tampered/non-executed evidence and non-zero PASS are rejected.

criteria.title: Replan, loop and budget safety
criteria.target: Semantic cycles, persisted iteration/cost/tool/model limits and restart continuation terminate safely with lineage.

criteria.title: Distributed fencing and CAS
criteria.target: Stale lease, double claim, approval race and lost optimistic update cannot settle current work.

criteria.title: Crash-aware effectively-once effects
criteria.target: Ambiguous effects remain UNKNOWN/UNCERTAIN and never blindly retry; idempotency is tenant and lineage scoped.
criteria.evidence: effect journal, outbox and chaos reports

criteria.title: End-to-end trace and evidence lineage
criteria.target: Inbound through response is reconstructable with bounded safe attributes and redacted logs.

criteria.title: Tenant and governance red team
criteria.target: Cross-tenant, untrusted actor, prompt/tool/channel injection and approval replay fail closed.

criteria.title: PostgreSQL and recovery proof
criteria.target: Migrations 0019/0020/0021, RLS, restart and restore paths are executed or honestly NOT_EXECUTED.

criteria.title: AAA operator console state matrix
criteria.target: Read-only operator states are accessible and usable at 375/768/1440 with fresh visual critique.
criteria.evidence: Playwright matrix, screenshots and independent critic

criteria.title: Production fail-closed preflight
criteria.target: Production-like config cannot start on memory/legacy runtime or missing durable identity/policy/risk/approval/journal/migrations.

criteria.title: CI and supply-chain integrity
criteria.target: Pinned CI, npm ci portability, secret/dependency/license/SBOM evidence and historical Phase 10 verification remain intact.

criteria.title: External qualification is separate
criteria.target: Real provider/channel/identity/RAG/RPO-RTO/pilot/rollback/signoff are validated only with authorized evidence.

criteria.title: Production remains protected
criteria.target: No real data, deployment or sensitive external effect occurs in this round.
criteria.evidence: preflight, bypass audit and execution log
